title: Pen Library for tiptoi
shortDescription: Load tiptoi book audio onto your pen directly from an Android phone over USB.
fullDescription:
Got a new tiptoi book? Send its audio straight from your Android phone to your pen. Use a compatible pen, a USB data cable and an adapter if needed. You can do it anywhere you have your phone and cable, without a computer, charging dock or account.

How it works
1. Connect the pen by USB and grant access to its top-level folder in Android.
2. Find the book in the German catalog and download its audio.
3. Choose Install on pen. Keep the app open and the pen connected until the transfer is verified. Then unplug the pen and try the book.

At home and on the go
• Save downloads on your phone to install later without internet. The Transfer only setting lets you download and install in one step.
• See which books are on each pen and how much space is free. Saved inventories are visible when the pens are unplugged.
• Remove individual books with a verified backup on your phone. Restore them offline when you need them.
• Name several pens and share a book selection. Review which books to add to each pen.

What you need
Android 8 or later, USB storage support (OTG), and a pen that appears as a USB drive. Tested with a fourth-generation tiptoi pen. Use a data-capable cable. Initial downloads need internet. Catalog audio is in German and plays through the pen. Open My pens to explore the read-only demo without hardware.

No ads or app analytics. Your library, pen profiles and backups stay on your device. The app requests catalog data, covers and audio directly from Ravensburger. Uninstalling or clearing app storage erases local downloads and backups.

Pen Library is an independent open-source app and is unaffiliated with Ravensburger. tiptoi is a Ravensburger trademark.
